claim: WildBox trajectories/results can be reported directly in meters.
reason: No verified source-specific metric-scale anchor was found in any of the three WildBox sources.

claim: WildBox camera intrinsics/extrinsics alone establish metric distance.
reason: Camera geometry exists, but the reconstruction scale is not independently verified in physical units.

claim: Normalized/image-plane WildBox ADE/FDE may be converted to meters using an assumed altitude.
reason: No measured or source-verified altitude/metric anchor was available; adding an assumed scale would create unsupported physical-error claims.

claim: WildBox supports external trajectory-forecasting evaluation in normalized/image space.
reason: The existing frozen WildBox forecasting results remain valid in their original reported coordinate representation; R18 does not invalidate those results.

claim: Meter-space evaluation is a current limitation that should be disclosed in the paper.
reason: All three sources contain camera geometry but zero verified metric-scale anchors.

claim: The available WildBox camera matrices may be described as world-ground-truth metric poses.
reason: Available intrinsics/extrinsics do not prove metric world coordinates or a known physical scale.
